title: ICLR 2027's new 1–4 scale: a 2, 2, 3 is better than it feels [P]
summary: ICLR 2027 moved to a 4-point scale (1 clear reject, 2 weak reject, 3 weak accept, 4 clear accept), so nobody has a feel yet for what a given set of scores means. We counted the public scores on OpenReview: 73,410 reviews on 23,759 submissions. A couple of things that surprised us
reason: Reddit discussion analyzing ICLR 2027 review score distributions is commentary/meta-analysis, not a new AI research result with a paper or official benchmark source (R2-1 unmet); no model release, business event, policy action, or OSS tool involved.
